title: Minimum Snap Polynomial Trajectory
text: Generate minimum snap polynomial trajectories through multiple waypoints, 7 inputs, 8 outputs, {Minimum segment time} sets Minimum time segment length; {Show boundary conditions input ports} sets the accept boundary condition inputs, {Show polynomial coefficients output port} sets the output polynomial coefficients, {Show status output port} sets the output status, {Time allocation} enables time allocation, {Time weight} sets the weight for time allocation, {Maximum segment time} sets the maximum time segment length, {Maximum iterations}, {Maximum time} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: Time point along trajectory scalar | vector

ports.name: Waypoints
ports.summary: Waypoints positions along trajectory n -by- p matrix

ports.name: TimePoints
ports.summary: Time points for waypoints of trajectory p -element row vector

ports.name: VelBC
ports.summary: Velocity boundary conditions for waypoints n -by- p matrix

ports.name: JerkBC

ports.name: SnapBC
ports.summary: Snap boundary conditions for waypoints n -by- p matrix

ports.name: q
